messages:
Jules (Support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting 429s + intermittent 500s after this morning's ratecap rollout. ACME ticket attached; they saw huge retry storms and billing spikes. Can we get a quick mitigation? :warning:

Mark (Eng-Platform): I rolled ratepolicy-v2 to a 10% canary at 09:12 UTC. Canary was supposed to be internal-only, but looks like ACME is in the target set due to an earlier test whitelist. Config change: `rate_limit_per_min: user: 600 -> 300` (half).

Anya (Eng-SRE): Observing proxy errors 09:15–09:26 from pool gc-7. 500s correlate with connection timeouts, not GPU saturation. Token service latency shows a tail at ~1.2s around the same window. Also seeing retries amplify traffic.

Mark (Eng-Platform): Confirmed ACME was accidentally included. I can remove them from the canary or push an exemption. Which do you prefer?

Jules (Support): Customer impact is high. Please exempt them immediately if that's quick. Also they reported billing anomalies when clients retried — billing ops needs to be alerted.

Anya (Eng-SRE): Quick mitigation: add ACME tenant pattern to rate-exempt table on control plane: ```rbac rate-exempt add acme-*``` I'll run it now and watch metrics. Also we should advise customers to implement exponential backoff and `Retry-After` honoring to avoid burst amplification.

deploy-bot: Pushed change `rl-v2-targeted-exempt` for acme-* at 09:31 UTC. Change id: deploy-rl-2035. Rolling to 100% for that target group only.

Mark (Eng-Platform): Exemption applied. 429s for ACME dropped back to baseline within 2 minutes. Leaving the broader canary paused for now. We'll replan the rollout with restricted test tenants and a slower ramp.

Jules (Support): I'll notify ACME (and the other affected customers) that we exempted them and are investigating billing. Can billing please open a ticket for the charge reconciliation?

ACME Ops: Thanks — we confirm the 429s have stopped. We'll hold on replays until you tell us it's safe. Can you share expected timeline for any invoice corrections?

Anya (Eng-SRE): Filing a short post-incident checklist: 1) Canary roster drift caused external tenancy inclusion. 2) No per-tenant override UI made emergency exemptions slower. 3) Telemetry gap: missing alert for per-tenant canary membership changes. Owner: Mark to follow up.

Mark (Eng-Platform): Action plan I will run: 1) Lock canary roster automation so external tenants can't be added without a manual approval gate. 2) Build per-tenant override UI + CLI for emergency exempts. 3) Add correlation dashboard for 429/500 vs ratepolicy rollouts. I'll schedule a rollback/retry rehearsal and add docs for recommended client retry behavior.

Jules (Support): Noted. I'll coordinate customer comms and escalate billing. Please post expected ETA for invoice updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Anya (Eng-SRE): I'll also add a short remediation runbook: how to identify retry storms (`p99_retries_per_min`), how to apply `rate-exempt`, and safe rollback steps. Will attach to the incident ticket.

Jules (Support): Closing loop once billing confirms. Thanks everyone for the quick fix.
